final_text:
I updated the wrap() function to implement the two improvements:

- It keeps paragraph breaks by splitting input text into paragraphs separated by blank lines, and in the output provides a single "" line between paragraphs. Multiple blank lines are treated as one. Leading and trailing blank lines are removed.

- It never splits URLs. If a URL (starting with http:// or https://) is longer than the width, it is placed on a line of its own.

Next, I will test the new wrap() function with various test cases to ensure it keeps paragraph breaks correctly and handles URLs properly.
